message.content: Based on the conversation, Gavriel expresses a preference for turn-based combat. This preference is highlighted in several exchanges. For instance, in one interaction, Gavriel states, "I really enjoy turn-based combat! It gives you time to think and plan your moves without feeling rushed." Additionally, Gavriel mentions liking "the blend of RPG elements and social simulation" in games like "Persona 5 Royal," noting its "strategic" nature. Furthermore, Gavriel appreciates the depth that turn-based combat offers in battles, saying, "It’s satisfying to outsmart my opponents, and I love the depth it offers in battles." Thus, from these discussions, we can infer that Gavriel prefers turn-based combat over real-time strategy.
